 This Petition Coming On For Preliminar Hearing
In B Group, This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The Petitioner has framed his Writ Petition with the following principal prayers:
"i) Issue a writ or order or direction directing the respondents 2 and 3 not to undertake any developmental activity in the land of the petitioner.
ii) Issue a writ or order or direction directing the respondents 2 and 3 and 4 to pay compensation of a sum of Rs.20 lakhs to the petitioner for the atrocities committed against the petitioner, demolishing the buildings and agony and torture to which the petitioner was subjected to."
2. Learned Senior Panel Counsel appearing for the BDA opposed the Petition contending that the Petitioner's land as described in the schedule has not been acquired at all & therefore, he can be rest assured of non-interference from the side of BDA thereto.

So far as second contention as to the alleged demolition of the structures existing therein is concerned, the learned Panel Counsel submits that it involves disputed questions of fact & therefore, the Petitioner has to be relegated to the Civil Court.
So contending, he seeks dismissal of the Writ Petition.

3. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and having perused the Petition Papers, this Court is not inclined to grant indulgence in the matter in view of assurance as to non-interference in Petitioner's land as described in the schedule to the Petition, coming from the respondent-BDA side.
This court is also in broad agreement with the submission made on behalf of the BDA that matter involving disputed fact has to get adjudicated before the Civil Court.
In that connection, all contentions are kept open.

In view of the above, Writ Petition is disposed off placing the assurance of the BDA on record reserving liberty to the Petitioner to take up the dispute to the Civil Court, in accordance with law,
